description.value:
The Flaming Fist, a burly mercenary company led by the grand duke, is the main law enforcement force of Baldur's Gate. You once served in its ranks, where you learned to head off trouble with an intimidating glare and, when needed, to shrug off deadly blows. Active or retired, the Fists are known as some of the toughest, most resilient warriors on the Sword Coast, and you mean to keep that reputation.

Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.LUeMriAibyVJHhaW]{Tough}

Skill Proficiencies: Intimidation and Perception

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulSmithsTool]{Smith's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepMace000000]{Mace}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulSmithsTool]{Smith's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagManacles000]{Manacles}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRamPortable]{Portable Ram}, 4 GP; or (B) 50 GP

PpVM2qnjuBcXiUkd.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Strength, Constitution, and Charisma scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
